objective: Experiment with multiple original RL implementations, replicate one or two author experiments, then assess adaptation to R1 Lite.
scope: Completion applies to original-method experimentation and the R1 Lite transfer assessment. It does not close the separate autonomous laundry request or establish matching paper performance.

requirements.evidence: Original FastTD3 completed its supported H1Hand Hurdle program. Original Mulligan completed IDQL and DIVL, 150,000 updates each. Real-Time EXPO additionally ran as a declared Catcher integration.

requirements.requirement: Replicate one or two author experiments
requirements.evidence: Original pinned released data and two-stage recipe, training seed 1, followed by original evaluation on all 8,000 locked starts with N32. The full-grid evaluation gap in the earlier audit is closed.
requirements.limits: Evaluation/reset seeds are explicitly 42/42, unlike unseeded defaults. Local 92.8625% differs from the author seed-1 reference 94.7125%. This establishes execution of the experiment, not numerical equivalence or the five-seed paper aggregate.

requirements.evidence: Published Leela 0.5.0 contracts inspected: 14 absolute arm/jaw targets, 15 Hz, fixed base/torso, zero step reward with a separate judge. Required reward, reset, timing and observation validation are documented.
requirements.limits: No R1 Lite learning, whole-body controller or hardware transfer is claimed.

requirements.requirement: Publish architecture, results and team explanation
requirements.evidence: Published results viewer passed actual desktop/mobile checks. Existing recordings were preserved. Reports and Mermaid sources define author, root, reviewer and Leela boundaries. Git release and board handoff follow this audit.

fasttd3.scope: Original current-release attempt; below released same-coordinate curve, one seed and nine printed physics warnings.

realtime_expo_catcher.scope: Original learner integration on reused starts from one layout. Training client SIGINT failure preserved; later checkpoint recovery and clean frozen trials accepted separately. No exact author simulation-recipe or reliable-improvement claim.

remaining_unproved: Full-grid local IDQL versus DIVL incremental benefit.
Fresh human-feedback collection or causal deployment-data scaling.
Exact author Real-Time EXPO simulation recipe where release configuration is missing.
R1 Lite native learner integration, learning or hardware transfer.
Autonomous Dyna laundry reproduction; current replay lacks grasp physics and the author policy/controller releases were not located.

verification.basis: 14 native-review inputs, 6 publication-acceptance inputs and 20 earlier completion-audit inputs. Existing native checker and actual browser evidence were inspected, not rerun.
verification.suite_limit: Earlier broad suite has 775 passed, 24 failed and 2 skipped. These known failures remain unresolved; this audit does not claim the whole repository is green.

ste_note: Uses ASD-STE100 guidance; full vocabulary and grammar compliance was not checked.
